title: googleapis JWT client built with positional arguments is silently unauthenticated
symptoms: 401 or 403 on every call from a service account
No error when constructing the client
cause: Newer googleapis versions expect the JWT constructor to take a single options object. Positional arguments are accepted without error but produce a client with no credentials.
apply: new google.auth.JWT({ email: sa.client_email, key: sa.private_key, scopes: ['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets'] })
affected: googleapis for Node v173 and later, July 2026
